title: How often should I clean my water tank in Dubai?
desc: For residential properties, an annual or semi-annual cleaning may be sufficient. However, for commercial or industrial properties, more frequent water tank cleaning services in Dubai may be necessary to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.

title: Is it safe to drink tap water in Dubai?
desc: If you have concerns about the quality of your drinking water, you're not alone. It's a responsible practice to assess the water you consume. According to DEWA, tap water in Dubai is safe to drink, as it undergoes rigorous testing and is certified for human consumption.
